generated tabs.py:368-376: activate_tab_by_number does `self.tabs[tab_number - 1].name` with no guard. A number greater than len(tabs), or any call on an empty Tabs, raises IndexError. The reference (reference tabs.py:298-309) returns silently when tab_number > len(self.tabs).

generated tabs.py:376 maps 0 to tabs[-1] (the last tab) regardless of tab count. The reference maps 0 to the 10th tab when len(tabs) >= 10 (reference tabs.py:306-309). The docstring at generated tabs.py:~370 documents the candidate's own behavior, which contradicts the reference.
The keyboard path (generated tabs.py:431-435) handles 0 and out-of-range digits correctly, so key-driven behavior matches the reference. The deviation is confined to the public direct-call method.
criteria.deficiency: activate_tab_by_number is public, and its contract differs from the reference in two cases: (1) out-of-range or empty-tabs calls raise IndexError instead of being ignored; (2) with 10 or more tabs, a direct call with 0 activates the last tab instead of the 10th. Fix by mirroring the reference guards: return if tab_number > len(tabs), and map 0 to index 9 when len(tabs) >= 10 (else last tab).

Minor, not failing: tabs.py mixes typing.List/Tuple/Optional (tabs.py:~5-7) with builtin list and `X | None` annotations used elsewhere in the same file. The _layout_resolve.py docstring edit is unnecessary but harmless.

Rendering: labels row plus underline. Active tab uses active style with no click meta (tabs.py:~ TabsRenderable.__rich_console__, active branch). Inactive tabs get click meta, opacity blending, and a padded selection span.

Keyboard: Escape clears focus, Left/Right wrap (tabs.py:399-438). Digits route through activate_tab_by_number, and 0 maps to the 10th tab when there are at least 10 tabs. Non-digit characters activate the next matching label, skipping the active tab (tabs.py:346-366). Propagation is not stopped, so app bindings still see keys. base message_pump.py:238 only stops the MRO handler walk, and bubbling is unaffected.
Clicks: `range_clicked(name)` activates the tab (tabs.py:378). Underline animates via watch__active_tab_name (tabs.py:386).

Duplicate names: _displayed_tabs (tabs.py:68) keeps the first position and last label, matching the reference. Navigation skips same-name tabs (tabs.py:326-343), a deliberate improvement over the reference.

Design differences that are not failures: can_focus = True (tabs.py:259) is added so keys can reach the widget; the reference does not set it. Zero-width labels are excluded from layout edges (tabs.py:~ `if label_width:`), which the reference does not handle (zero size is treated as flexible there).
The one behavioral gap is the direct activate_tab_by_number contract, recorded under api_contract. The keyboard behavior the feature requires is correct.
